description: A Python script providing utility functions for WebIDL code generation, including handling extended attributes, naming conventions, exposure checks, and interface member classification.

classes.name: ExposureSet
classes.description: A collection of Exposure instructions with methods to compare, add, and generate code for exposure checks.

methods.name: extended_attribute_value_contains
methods.description: Checks if an extended attribute value contains a specific key.

methods.name: has_extended_attribute
methods.description: Checks if a definition or member has a specific extended attribute.

methods.name: has_extended_attribute_value
methods.description: Checks if a definition or member has a specific extended attribute with a given value.

methods.name: extended_attribute_value_as_list
methods.description: Returns the extended attribute value as a list.

methods.name: capitalize
methods.description: Capitalizes the first letter or acronym in a name.

methods.name: strip_suffix
methods.description: Removes a suffix from a string if present.

methods.name: uncapitalize
methods.description: Uncapitalizes the first letter or acronym in a name.

methods.name: runtime_enabled_function
methods.description: Returns a string representing a runtime enabled feature function call.

methods.name: unique_by
methods.description: Filters a list of dicts to unique elements based on a key.

methods.name: scoped_name
methods.description: Generates a C++ scoped name for an interface member.

methods.name: v8_class_name
methods.description: Returns the V8 class name for an interface.

methods.name: v8_class_name_or_partial
methods.description: Returns the V8 class name or its partial variant if interface is partial.

methods.name: activity_logging_world_list
methods.description: Returns set of worlds for activity logging based on extended attributes.

methods.name: activity_logging_world_check
methods.description: Determines if an isolated world check is needed for activity logging.

methods.name: call_with_arguments
methods.description: Returns a list of call arguments based on extended attribute values.

methods.name: is_constructor_attribute
methods.description: Checks if a member has a constructor-related extended attribute.

methods.name: deprecate_as
methods.description: Returns the deprecation attribute if present.

methods.name: exposed
methods.description: Generates code to check if a member is exposed in a given context.

methods.name: secure_context
methods.description: Generates code to check if an interface/member is in a secure context.

methods.name: cpp_name
methods.description: Returns the implementation name for a definition or member.

methods.name: cpp_name_from_interfaces_info
methods.description: Gets implementation name from interfaces info.

methods.name: cpp_name_or_partial
methods.description: Returns class name or partial class name if interface is partial.

methods.name: measure_as
methods.description: Returns measure name for a member, adding includes as needed.

methods.name: origin_trial_enabled_function_name
methods.description: Returns the function name for origin trial enablement.

methods.name: origin_trial_feature_name
methods.description: Gets feature name from extended attributes.

methods.name: runtime_enabled_feature_name
methods.description: Returns runtime enabled feature name, adding includes.

methods.name: is_unforgeable
methods.description: Checks if a member is unforgeable.

methods.name: is_legacy_interface_type_checking
methods.description: Checks for legacy interface type checking attribute.

methods.name: on_instance
methods.description: Determines if a member should be defined on each instance object.

methods.name: on_prototype
methods.description: Determines if a member should be defined on the prototype object.

methods.name: on_interface
methods.description: Checks if a member should be defined on the interface object.

methods.name: legacy_caller
methods.description: Retrieves the legacy caller method if present.

methods.name: indexed_property_getter
methods.description: Retrieves the getter method for indexed properties.

methods.name: indexed_property_setter
methods.description: Retrieves the setter method for indexed properties.

methods.name: indexed_property_deleter
methods.description: Retrieves the deleter method for indexed properties.

methods.name: named_property_getter
methods.description: Retrieves the getter method for named properties.

methods.name: named_property_setter
methods.description: Retrieves the setter method for named properties.

methods.name: named_property_deleter
methods.description: Retrieves the deleter method for named properties.
